mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_image (user_id, topic_id, filename, oss_url, storage_type, file_size, is_public, audit_status, upload_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{topicId}, #{filename}, #{ossUrl}, #{storageType}, #{fileSize}, 0, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, topic_id AS topicId, filename, oss_url AS ossUrl, storage_type AS storageType, file_size AS fileSize, is_public AS isPublic, audit_status AS auditStatus, upload_time AS uploadTime FROM biz_image WHERE audit_status != 4 AND id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_image SET audit_status = 4 WHERE id IN #{id} AND audit_status IN (0, 2, 3)
